patch_description: The current program's trade frequency (323 trades) is significantly lower than the high-performing seed program (462 trades), primarily due to restrictive microstructure filters (obi > -0.5 and spread < 6.0). This edit lowers the entry threshold to 0.0017 and loosens the filters to be more inclusive (spread < 10.0, rsi filters, and a wider obi range). It also introduces a slight position size boost for high-confidence predictions and a session-based hold time adjustment to capture US session momentum.
